name: Bowie Sanders
source:
Looks like a pretty boy or an androgynous woman, but is indeed biologically a male by sex. Has a nasty attitude and habits.
Forced to socially transition to female by their family and then medically by another character, Bowie struggles severely with gender identity issues. 
[Depending on the ending that the player gets, Bowie leans toward one gender over the other.]
{canonically a genderqueer/transgender character as according to author}
